findings.invariant: A replacement prepared must not be governed by an already-revoked old reply deadline, while valid new reply deadlines must not be suppressed
findings.reproducer: controlled same-scope prepared replacement during old generation cancellation, using actual decision producer and separately live ResponseBudget
findings.cause: stop returns on prepared identity change without retiring still-old reply deadline; monitor settlement token omits prepared/reply-deadline identity, then polls old expired deadline after settlement clears
findings.suggestion: Track the revoked reply/deadline owner separately; retire only still-owned old reply deadline after confirmed stop, preserve new prepared and its original budget. Do not simply poll the old deadline when prepared changes or reset/renew new deadlines.

positive_boundaries: confirmed plain stop clears old reply only, TTL/heartbeat unchanged
TTL and heartbeat expire during actual cancellation window
commands exception clears settling token but does not falsely zero deadline or renew lease
poll_visual exception actual run completes closed/inactive
runner controls/stage/reason unknown values sanitized, exception body not accessed
unconfirmed resource continues failclosed in targeted tests
scope: controlled clocks and synthetic provider/transport only; new prepared injected via actual internal decision callback under concurrency invariant requested, not end-to-end wire scheduling or frequency proof
clock_note: Initial poll_visual test asserted session state before run finally completed; corrected to await actual run task and now PASS. Initial log preserved, not a second product defect.
